messages:
jules: quick blocker on my docs PR (#534). the JS and Python streaming examples for function-calling currently imply the server will deliver the final function_call if the stream errors. runtime: is that accurate today?

ana: @jules can you paste the snippet you used so we can be concrete? reviewers flagged the wording as risky.

jules: JS snippet: 
```js
const s = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-lite', messages, functions: [spec], stream: true });
for await (const ev of s) {
  if (ev.function_call) handle(ev.function_call)
}
```

jules: question: if the runtime streams a few chunks then a transient error occurs, does it (A) close the stream with an error frame only, or (B) fall back server-side and send the full function_call?

tim: product: we should doc the current default and show a tiny defensive client example. customers will rely on that behavior when migrating.

riley: runtime update: current behavior = close with error frame. no automatic server-side fallback in prod. planned feature tracked (INFR-812).

ana: can you paste the exact error envelope we should show so SDKs can pattern-match? also what HTTP status is returned?

riley: error chunk follows the streaming error schema: `\{"type":"error","code":"internal","message":"runtime: GPU OOM","details":{"transient":true}\}` sent as the final chunk, then the connection is closed and the overall HTTP response is 500.

jules: thanks. proposed doc wording to insert: "Runtime note: on transient runtime failures the stream will be closed with an error frame (see error schema). The server will not automatically switch to a non-streamed response today; clients should implement retry/fallback patterns. Server-side automatic fallback is planned."

tim: nice. also add a compact defensive snippet for JS and PY and move longer recipes to a gist to avoid docs renderer flakiness. e.g. JS try/catch around the for-await loop and retry once non-streaming.

ana: reviewers asked for a one-line compat note in the Migration Guide and SDK-compat doc so people searching will find it. add that too.

jules: will push three commits: (1) replace the misleading sentence with the proposed runtime note, (2) add compact defensive snippets for JS/PY, (3) add migration guide compat one-liner + roadmap callout.

ci-bot: docs preview queued for branch docs/pr-534 (job 113452).

docs-bot: preview failed on first attempt (renderer error parsing fenced block). suggestion: shorten inline fence and link to gist.

jules: i'll shorten fences and push again.

docs-bot: received push -> preview job 113453 queued. preview succeeded. link: https://ci.redwood/preview/113453 (status: success).

jules: thanks all, removing blocker label for reviewers. will ping again if runtime team updates behavior.

ana: thanks @jules. riley pls ping infra when INFR-812 lands so we can add a follow-up doc change that documents server-side fallback behavior.

riley: will do.

jules: closing thread.
